evidence_tiers.none: No auditable real-use or behavioral evidence is recorded.
evidence_tiers.observed: At least one auditable real-use observation exists.
evidence_tiers.repeated: Auditable real-use observations exist across multiple milestones/tasks.
evidence_tiers.benchmarked: At least one reproducible comparative behavioral evaluation exists.

records.claim: The named skills were used during committed GrowthOps M01-M04 work and the resulting engineering changes/tests align with their guidance.
records.does_not_claim: A controlled skill-on versus skill-off causal improvement.
records.privacy: Public commit/checkpoint facts only; private Codex transcripts and unfinished GrowthOps M05 work are excluded.
